title: Chit-Chat Cuttlefish
statement: A thumb-sized cuttlefish who greets every face at the glass with rippling skin-patterns, part hello and part question, never quite the same twice. Between visitors it drifts through its dawn-lit garden of seagrass and sea-glass, rearranging pebbles into little patterns only it can read and pausing now and then to look thoroughly delighted with them.
